post.text:
Remote control is now live in the Copilot CLI!

Run Copilot on your local machine, leave it plugged in, head to the beach, and drive the agent from your mobile phone 😎 https://t.co/0pDSQdItkS

Blog post: https://t.co/0MJbwwyexA
